title: stachys germanica var. alpina
intro: Stachys germanica var. alpina, commonly known as Alpine Betony, is a perennial herbaceous plant that belongs to the mint family (Lamiaceae) and is native to Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Betony include acting as a nervine, sedative, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it effective in treating anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Betony include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
